title: eVTOL 乘客航空器系統整合
summary: 以「整合分散推進、能源及熱管理的假想eVTOL系統」為主線，在非飛行eVTOL能量與系統介面工作台中依序完成理想盤面功率的下限、多級轉換效率及輸入、馬達損失與熱源、分散馬達的共因假設、多轉子頻率與聲學背景及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Integrate distributed propulsion, energy and cooling in a hypothetical eVTOL in a Non-flying eVTOL energy and interface bench, progressing through Ideal disk-power lower bound, Conversion efficiency and input power, Motor losses as heat sources, Common-cause assumptions for distributed motors, Multirotor frequency and acoustic context, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 理想盤面功率的下限：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Ideal disk-power lower bound: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 理想盤面功率的下限 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Ideal disk-power lower bound and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「eVTOL 乘客航空器系統整合」中，本單元處理「理想盤面功率的下限」。理想致動盤在靜止空氣中的誘導功率與推力的3/2次方相關；面積、密度與損失都重要。
steps.instructionEn: Within Passenger eVTOL systems integration, this unit examines Ideal disk-power lower bound. An ideal actuator disk in still air has induced power proportional to thrust to the three-halves power; area, density and losses matter.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：推力 T=20 N、空氣密度ρ=1.2 kg/m³、總盤面積A=0.4 m²。關係式 Pi=T^1.5/sqrt(2ρA)；含輸出單位換算的算式 20**1.5/sqrt(2*1.2*0.4)，結果 91.287093 W。適用範圍：理想靜止致動盤下限，不含剖面功、尾流干擾與電效率；不作飛行任務規劃。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Thrust T=20 N, air density rho=1.2 kg/m3 and total disk area A=0.4 m2. Relation Pi=T^1.5/sqrt(2ρA); evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 20**1.5/sqrt(2*1.2*0.4) gives 91.287093 W. Applicability: Ideal static-disk lower bound excluding profile power, wake interaction and electrical loss; not flight planning.
steps.failure: 在「理想盤面功率的下限」的情境中，多旋翼尾流重疊時，直接把盤面積相加可能過於樂觀。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Ideal disk-power lower bound, Overlapping wakes can make summed disk area an optimistic assumption.
steps.check: 針對「理想盤面功率的下限」，把理想流體功率、軸功率與電功率分列，避免混稱效率。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Ideal disk-power lower bound, Separate ideal fluid, shaft and electrical power instead of conflating efficiencies. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

steps.objective: 辨識 馬達軸功與力矩 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Motor shaft power and torque and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「eVTOL 乘客航空器系統整合」中，本單元處理「馬達軸功與力矩」。軸功率為力矩乘角速度；rpm需先換成rad/s，才能與瓦特建立一致單位。

steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Torque tau=5 N m and speed n=1800 rpm. Relation P=τ2πn/60; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 5*2*pi*1800/60 gives 942.4778 W. Applicability: Steady fixed torque; real motors cannot necessarily maintain it at every speed.
